expectations.text: States plainly that the recent-charge lookup is not sufficient
expectations.evidence: "This is not enough. You already have proof it isn't — this is the second time."

expectations.text: Identifies the lookup as a check-then-act race rather than a device
expectations.evidence: "Race condition | Two workers can both pass the check before either writes" and "check-before-write pattern ... The race window between checking and writing is exactly where duplicates slip through"; also "It's a check, not a constraint"

expectations.text: Recommends a required idempotency key on the charge path
expectations.evidence: "charge(customerId, amount, idempotencyKey) — no optional, no default" / "Make idempotency key a required parameter to charge functions"

expectations.text: Recommends a database unique constraint backing the idempotency key
expectations.evidence: "Add UNIQUE(customer_id, idempotency_key) constraint on charges table ... a constraint that the database enforces atomically"

expectations.text: Separates the defect from the mistake from the underlying system hazard
expectations.evidence: Table: "Defect | 340 customers double-charged", "Mistake | Retry path called charge again without an idempotency key", "Hazard | The payment system has no mechanism..."

expectations.text: Locates the hazard as a system property rather than as a worker bug or human error
expectations.evidence: "The payment system has no mechanism that makes duplicate charges for the same logical intent impossible" and "Nothing stops a future code path from skipping it"

expectations.text: Sweeps for other non-idempotent side effects reachable from a retry
expectations.evidence: "Class Sweep ... Every other queue consumer that calls a payment endpoint / Any webhook handler that triggers charges / Subscription renewal jobs / Retry/recovery scripts ... likely exists at multiple sites"

expectations.text: Treats 'second time this happened' as evidence for pushing to a Control-rung device
expectations.evidence: "if a mistake has happened twice, the system is telling you exactly where to install a device" + "The Device You Need: Idempotency Key (Rung 1 — Control)"

expectations.text: Attributes cause to the system, not to any person
expectations.evidence: Cause framed throughout as missing system constraint ("It's a check, not a constraint", "no idempotency at all"); no individual or team blamed anywhere
